name: The Byrne Unit

evidence.note: Band site says sets are adjusted in real time to keep the dance floor active.
Band promises a packed dance floor and lists rock, pop, country, Motown, funk and Top 40.
Lists regular venues including Salt Shack at Cedar Beach, Toomey's and Lily Flanagan's.

dancing.notes: A party cover band for bars, beach clubs and weddings. The band says it shapes each set live to keep the dance floor busy.

description: An Amityville-based cover band that plays classic rock, pop, country, Motown and Top 40 hits at Long Island bars, beach clubs and weddings.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Dance claims come from the band's own marketing; no crowd video watched.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website footer links a generic Instagram 'popular' search page and bare tiktok.com / x.com placeholders, so no Instagram, TikTok or X is recorded. The only published email is a member's Yahoo address that the band's own contact page gives for bookings ('Email: Dave'); recorded because the band publishes it for bookings, but the owner may prefer to show only the contact page. Facebook URL now has a trailing slash (same page as current). Current description and genres still fit; site FAQ says rock, country, rap and pop from the 1960s to present (Motown/funk in current genres was not re-confirmed on the site).

evidence.note: About page: a five-piece cover band from Amityville covering rock, country, rap and pop from the 1960s to now; played Salt Shack, Toomey's, Lily Flanagan's Babylon and Massapequa Park After Dark.
Contact page titled 'Book The Byrne Unit' has an inquiry form, links the Facebook page and lists an email for Dave as the booking contact.
Lily Flanagan's (Babylon) calendar lists The Byrne Unit for a happy-hour show on Oct 16, 2026, matching our listing.
